This black, short-sleeve t-shirt is made from 100% pre-shrunk cotton and features a screen-printed design. Produced in the USA, the garment is machine washable and available in size X-Large. It is an officially licensed product from Smack Apparel Inc.

specs.Footbed: Soft EVA with anatomical arch support

record.description: These Reef boys' sandals feature a vegan leather upper with a jersey lining and a soft EVA footbed with anatomical arch support. The flexible Triple Density EVA construction provides movement, while the molded high-density EVA outsole offers multi-directional traction. They are available in aqua and green.

This white Real Madrid home jersey for kids features a regular fit with a crewneck and short sleeves. Made from 100% recycled polyester doubleknit, it includes sweat-wicking Climalite fabric and mesh underarm inserts. The garment also features a woven team crest.
This Hyperkin HDTV cable connects all Saturn models to HDTVs. It supports 720p resolution for clear picture and audio. The set includes a 7-foot main cable and a 6-foot micro cable.

These polarized replacement lenses feature a dark silver mirror coating with 6% light transmission. Designed for Oakley Holbrook frames starting with OO9102 (55mm size), they are 1.4 mm thick and meet ANSI Z80.3 standards for UV protection and impact resistance. The package includes two lenses only.

specs.Support Features: Arch support, heel cup, and toe bar

record.description: These Bionica Nimah thong sandals feature fabric straps and a soft nubuck toe post. The design includes a quick-drying molded EVA footbed with arch support, a heel cup, and a toe bar. They are built with a shock-absorbing EVA midsole and a slip-resistant rubber outsole.

This heavyweight jumbo pet bowl is designed for extra-large breed dogs. It features a rubber bottom to prevent sliding on smooth surfaces and is dishwasher safe for easy cleaning. The product is available in various colors.

This officially licensed LEGO Batman wall poster measures 22.375" x 34". Printed on FSC-certified gloss poster paper, the unframed artwork features high-resolution graphics. It can be displayed using various mounting methods like clips or thumb tacks in any room.

This 3-pack of Carter's toddler tank tops features sleeveless designs in blue, orange, and gray. The shirts include ribbed necklines and pocket details. This set is sized 3T and comes in tagless packaging.

This pack contains 75 kraft corrugated double wall boxes measuring 48" L x 40" W x 36" H. Made from 275# D.W./ECT-48 material, these large containers are designed for bulky items and are compatible with Gaylord lids. They are shipped flat in pallet quantities.

specs.charging: External USB port and headphone hole

record.description: This black Seoky Rop sling bag is made of water-resistant PU leather and weighs 0.69 lb. It features adjustable nylon straps, multiple compartments for organization, and an anti-theft interlayer. The bag includes an external USB charging port, a headphone hole, and measures 13.8 x 6.7 x 3.2 inches.

This 5.5-inch hand-painted resin figure by artist Susan Lordi depicts an older woman and a young girl sitting on a gray bench. The cream-colored figures are holding hands and are suitable for display on shelves or tables. It includes an enclosure card and comes in a fitted gift box.

specs.Features: Replaceable wire cutters, blade exchanger, one-hand opening

record.description: The Leatherman Surge is a heavy-duty stainless steel multitool featuring 21 tools, including large pliers and spring-action scissors. It includes a blade exchanger, replaceable wire cutters, and one-hand opening capabilities. The tool comes with a premium nylon sheath and a 25-year warranty.

This white double-breasted chef's jacket features short sleeves and a ten-button closure that allows for reversible wear. It includes a matching chef hat with a velcro fastener. This set is sized small and is designed for professional kitchen use.

These 3MM neoprene gloves feature a flexible, form-fitting design with a high-grip textured palm for various water sports. They include an adjustable velcro wrist strap for a secure fit and are constructed with blind stitching for added durability. These gloves are suitable for men, women, and children.

specs.Care: Machine washable cold, tumble dry low

record.description: These girls' denim shortalls feature a center front zipper, adjustable straps, and multiple pockets. Designed with LYCRA for stretch, they include a 3-inch cuffed inseam and are machine washable. This small-sized garment comes in the color Belle.

This space gray aluminum USB-C hub features four USB 3.0 ports with data transfer speeds up to 5Gbps. It includes a Type-C port supporting up to 60W power delivery and is compatible with various laptops, including MacBook Pro, Surface, and Chromebook models.

This official Alex Grey poster measures 18 inches by 24 inches. Produced as a museum-quality item, the artwork features a design centered on the theme of human consciousness as a bridge between planetary and cosmic consciousness.

This ALPS Mountaineering low rocker features a powder-coated steel frame and breathable TechMesh fabric. It has a 300-pound weight capacity and a foldable design that includes a shoulder bag for transport. The chair measures 22" W x 17" D x 31" H and weighs 11 lbs.

This pack of two size D batteries is an official accessory for the Good Guys doll. Produced by Trick Or Treat Studios and Universal Studios, these batteries are designed based on onscreen and behind-the-scenes details from Child's Play 2.
